title: Vulcan OSC depth-6 due-diligence status
summary: The public chronology now distinguishes investment, reported intervention, conditional commitment and later oversight, but does not establish loan closing or disbursement.

Office of Strategic Capital Agrees to Joint $700M Conditional Loan Commitment
Company Tied to Donald Trump Jr. Got a Deal After White House Intervened
Warren, Crow Demand Answers on Federal Contracts Benefiting Trump Family
Rare earths startup ReElement no longer seeking $80 million Pentagon loan

chronology.event: 1789 Capital disclosed as participant in Vulcan's $65 million Series A; individual stake undisclosed.
ProPublica reported OSC learned of a White House request initiated by Peter Navarro.
OSC announced a $620 million conditional commitment to Vulcan and a separate $80 million commitment to ReElement.
Warren and Crow requested records concerning the process and communications.
ReElement stopped seeking its separate loan after reported diligence difficulties; Vulcan said its loan remained on track.

resolved: investment preceded conditional commitment by about three months
reported White House initiation prompted congressional scrutiny
value.interpretation: The record supports a compressed and politically initiated review allegation, but it does not prove that OSC skipped diligence or that Vulcan received disbursed funds.

gaps: Executed financing documents and disbursement records remain missing from the public record.
